visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white t-shirt and loose jeans dances and squats playfully with a young girl in a floral dress in front of a large blue and green floral mural. (2) The scene transitions to an exterior shot of the BabyCity Taoyuan Flagship Store, featuring a modern blue perforated facade and large glass windows. (3) Inside the store, a large central tree installation with green moss-like mounds serves as a focal point in a bright, high-ceilinged atrium with white walls. (4) Various baby products are displayed on sleek white shelves, including Pigeon brand bottles, colorful blankets, nursing pillows, and children's clothing. (5) The camera moves through the "Baby Cafe" area, showing customers sitting on blue benches and a minimalist white coffee bar with a professional espresso machine. (6) Specialized services are shown, including a digital queue display board, an automated Brother embroidery machine stitching a name onto fabric, and tidy nursing facilities. (7) The final sequence features the mother and child interacting with toys, showcasing strollers, and smiling at the camera amidst a brightly lit retail environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a driving, high-tempo electronic pop beat featuring bright synthesizers and a strong 4/4 drum pattern. A male narrator delivers an enthusiastic intro in a professional, energetic tone. (2) As the store features are listed, a subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights the text overlays. The narrator's speech is rapid but articulate, maintaining a positive emotional valence. (3) The acoustic texture shifts briefly to include the rhythmic mechanical whirring and needle impacts of an embroidery machine, layered under the music. (4) Faint, processed sounds of children's laughter and light giggling are mixed into the background during scenes of play. (5) The music continues at a steady volume while the narrator concludes with a high-arousal call to action, finishing with a crisp fade-out of the master track.
